name: Chao Zhang
headline: VP of Product Management @ Wyze Labs | Product Strategy
summary:
At Wyze Labs, my leadership has been instrumental in expanding our security camera and video doorbell product lines, growing our portfolio from 2 to 20+ products across 6 product lines. Our team has successfully launched multiple award-winning products, securing #1 spots in North America.

Previously, as a Co-Founder and CTO at Ubi Interactive, I spearheaded technology and product development, which entailed overseeing cross-functional teams and guiding products from ideation to mass production. My expertise lies in aligning product roadmaps with market research, competitive analysis, and technological advancements to create impactful solutions. I am dedicated to delivering exceptional products that enhance security and convenience for millions of users worldwide.

positions.title: Co-Founder | Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Ubi is a VC-backed Seattle-based startup incubated by Microsoft Accelerator ran by TechStars. Ubi interactive develops and sells a gestural control solution to turn any surface into a 3D multi-touch screen. Featured in world’s leading tech journals including CNN, Wired and WSJ. It currently serves 1000+ organizations. 

•	Oversee the technology and product development, manufacturing and sourcing.
•	Launch 4 products from ideation to mass production by leading cross-functional internal and external, onshore/offshore teams through the product dev cycle. 
•	Define product roadmap based on market research, competitive analysis, user studies, technology advancement and business impacts.
•	Lead dev team to build 4 desktop apps, 2 mobile apps, 10+ companion apps, highly scalable in-house licensing and telemetry system supports 1000+ organizations in real time.
•	Familiar with agile development, bug tracking and project management tools such as JIRA, Trello, SourceTree, BitBucket and Zoho.
•	Conduct meetings with key accounts and partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, execution plans and follow-through the deployment and/or mass production.
•	Package Ubi’s product as SDK and standard hardware module to power customers’ use cases in education, entertainment, retail, engineering, smart-home and public sectors.
•	Coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver products as planned.
•	Synthesize and analyze key performance indicators from different sources to identify new use cases, new markets, improve user experience and evolve products continuously. 
•	Evaluate vendors, negotiate contracts, develop and manage the sourcing strategy and product manufacturing.

company.name: Wyze
company.tagline: On a mission to make smart home technology accessible to everyone
company.description:
The founding members of Wyze met when they were working at Amazon and they brought the core Amazon principles to us - it’s our goal to become the most customer-centric technology company. We’re passionate about providing customers high-quality products at great prices.

Our first product, Wyze Cam, is the solution to a problem that one of our co-founders faced. He had been looking for a smart home camera to stay connected and protect his family with while on the road. He found that better-recognized brands were overpriced for their quality and cheaper ones were unreliable. We believe consumers deserve better than that and this led to the birth of Wyze Cam.

But this is just the beginning. As we grow, we will continue to launch high quality, affordable tech products that enrich people’s lives and make great technology accessible to everyone.

Our cameras, smart devices, and Wyze app are meticulously designed with multiple layers of security to help give you peace of mind. Your safety is our priority. For more information, visit www.wyze.com.
